library.name: Main Library
library.intro: The Main Library is in the Library Building, with the Old Wing (opened 1961) and the New Wing (opened 1991); Level 3 is on 3/F. It has over 1,900 seats, with study tables on every floor.

spots.name: Fung Ping Shan Library
spots.text: Part of the Chinese library: Chinese and Japanese books, call numbers DS741–Z.

spots.name: Fung Ping Shan Library
spots.text: Chinese and Japanese books, call numbers A–DS740, plus oversized books and large series.

spots.name: Bookable study tables
spots.text: 64 seats on 4/F can be booked online (Book a Study Table); rules are in the Booking Policy.

spots.name: Single Study Rooms
spots.text: HKU / SPACE students and staff can book them in the Facilities Booking System: 3 sessions a day, bookable one session ahead; released if you don't check in within 60 minutes of the start.

spots.name: Western-language books 001–299
spots.text: Also Education Collection books, and Fung Ping Shan Library Chinese reference books and periodicals.

spots.name: Western-language books 300–399
spots.text: Plus reference books and periodicals for 001–399.

spots.name: Tin Ka Ping Education Library (discussion rooms)
spots.text: 18 discussion rooms are booked online, up to 2 hours per person per day, released if you don't check in within 15 minutes of the start; there are also collaborative areas that need no booking. Laptops for the rooms can be borrowed at the 2/F Lending Services Counter.

spots.name: Technology Zone
spots.text: Over 100 computers, bookable online, with Microsoft Office, EndNote and more; some have SPSS, NVivo and scanners (A3 flatbed scanning: computers 66 and 73).

spots.name: Study Zone (quiet study)
spots.text: Various single seats for quiet study; quiet discussion is allowed in the other Level 3 zones.

spots.name: Ko Wong Wai Ching Wendy Fine Arts Digital Library
spots.text: The fine arts digital library, also on Level 3.

spots.name: Lending Services Counter
spots.text: Borrow and return books, collect requested items and interlibrary loans; borrow laptops, tablets, noise-cancelling headphones and other equipment. The Add Value Machine next to it tops up your print quota with Octopus.

spots.name: Enquiries Counter
spots.text: Library membership, reader cards for access to other non-UGC libraries, and more.

spots.name: Self-Service Collection
spots.text: Tap your student card to enter and pick up course reserve items and books you requested (arranged by surname); there is an A3 overhead scanner inside.

spots.name: Battery Charging Stations
spots.text: Next to the Atrium, with Type-C, Lightning and Micro-B cables for 7 devices at once; please keep to 30 minutes when others are waiting.

spots.name: Ingenium
spots.text: An interdisciplinary technology space with exhibition and event areas, the Library Innovation Centre and Tech@Ingenium.

spots.name: Special Study Room
spots.text: For students with visual impairments, with screen readers and braille equipment; students registered with CEDARS tap their card to enter.

spots.name: Western-language books 900–999
spots.text: Plus reference books and periodicals in the same range.

spots.name: AV Collection
spots.text: Audio-visual materials, plus reference books and periodicals for 400–599.

spots.name: Special Collections
spots.text: Hong Kong materials, microforms, rare books and WTO materials; some items must be requested at the Special Collections Counter.

spots.name: HKU Archives
spots.text: 1/F Rm 114–117, for use in the library only; email to request materials before you visit.

spots.name: Western-language books 400–599, 700–799
spots.text: Also the Music Collection (books, scores and audio-visual materials).

spots.name: Library 24 Study Hub
spots.text: Separate from the main library and open 24 hours to HKU staff and students, with its entrance facing the Sun Yat-sen Steps; for emergencies after the library closes, call the Security Control Centre on 3917-2882.

spots.name: Think Tank
spots.text: Enter by the G/F Ancillary Entrance: first the Social Space and Leisure Study Space, then further in the Quiet Study Space and Deep Quiet Study Space, plus the Special Collections Joseph Needham Room and a Seminar Room.

spots.name: Research Carrels
spots.text: With lockers, for HKU higher degree students on master's or doctoral programmes only; allocated by half-month through an online application and ballot, and you must check in within the first 3 days; ask at the 2/F counter for details.

spots.name: E-Learning Lab
spots.text: A small multi-purpose lecture room with 46 seats, each with a networked computer, used for library talks and seminars.

spots.name: Western-language books 600–699, 800–899
spots.text: Also oversized books and the Leisure Reading Collection.
